tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one brand hue. antd colorPrimary and colorInfo, antd-mobile --adm-color-primary, browser theme-color, selected menu item, active hub tab, chart bars, KPI sub-line, card hover border. White text on it is 10.3:1.

tokens.name: brand-dark
tokens.usage: Desktop Sider and Menu background, mobile drawer brand band. Carries white (16.2:1), on-dark-muted and on-dark-faint text.

tokens.name: brand-deeper
tokens.usage: Dark Menu sub-item background and the API preview code block ground (code-ink on it, 13.5:1).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind panes, mobile sections and the tablet detail pane.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panes, KPI and task cards, header, mobile NavBar and TabBar, list pane.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Summary bar, favourite chips, step-strip cells, inactive mobile hub tabs.

tokens.name: surface-tint-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of favourite chips.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected table row and the schedule time block (brand text on it, 9.3:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Fill of the emphasised pane at the top of a sales detail (SalesDetail).

tokens.name: highlight-border
tokens.usage: Border of the emphasised sales-detail pane.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairline on panes, cards, header, NavBar, TabBar and the tablet split. Decorative only: 1.2:1 on surface, so never the sole edge of an input.

tokens.name: border-row
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside widgets (schedule rows, visit rows).

tokens.name: border-chip
tokens.usage: Favourite-chip outline.

tokens.name: axis
tokens.usage: Baseline under mini bar charts.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, values, amounts and body text on surface (14.1:1), bg (13.1:1) and notice-bg.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: summary-bar copy and inactive hub tabs on surface or surface-tint (6.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels above figures (KPI, task card, list sub-lines) on surface (4.6:1). On surface-tint it falls to 4.1:1, under AA for small text: kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: The .muted helper text, empty states, chart axis labels. Only 3.1:1 on surface and 2.8:1 on bg, under AA at 12px: kept exact from the source; prefer ink-muted for anything a user must read.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on brand, brand-dark and brand-deeper: the SOMANSA wordmark, active tabs.

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Wordmark subline (SALES WORKSPACE · …) on brand-dark (8.1:1).

tokens.name: on-dark-faint
tokens.usage: Sider footer line on brand-dark (4.8:1).

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Code and JSON text on brand-deeper in the API preview.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done states: approved cert, OK step cell text, probability ≥ 90%, mapping rate ≥ 80%. 5.6:1 on surface, 4.9:1 on success-bg.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Completed step-strip cell.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs-attention text: hot task-card counts, warning list items, warning step cell. 4.4:1 on surface and 4.1:1 on warning-bg, just under AA at small sizes: kept exact; it is used bold at 12–20px.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning step-strip cell.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Counts that demand action: unresolved TQS exceptions, receivables for collection, missing report items; similarity < 70%. 5.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Progress-bar stroke only, for the middle band (mapping rate < 80%, similarity 70–89%). 2.4:1 on surface: never text.

tokens.name: notice
tokens.usage: 4px left rule on notice cards (공지). A mark, not text.

tokens.name: notice-bg
tokens.usage: Notice-card fill; ink text on it.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Probability bar stroke below 50%.

families.sans: 'Pretendard', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Noto Sans KR', system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark in the desktop Sider (18px in the mobile drawer). Always on brand-dark in on-dark.

styles.name: wordmark-sub
styles.usage: The line under the wordmark, in on-dark-muted.

styles.name: pane-title

styles.name: kpi-value

styles.name: task-value
styles.usage: Count on a task card; turns warning when hot.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amount at the right of a mobile list item.
